sections.name: DESIGNATION FORM
sentences: The category of the case is to be indicated for the purpose of assignment to the appropriate calendar.

sections.name: RELATED CASE, IF ANY
sentences: Civil cases are deemed related when Yes is answered to any of the following questions:.
Is this case related to property included in an earlier numbered suit pending or within one year previously terminated action in this court?
Does this case involve the same issue of fact or grow out of the same transaction as a prior suit pending or within one year previously terminated action in this court?
Does this case involve the validity or infringement of a patent already in suit or any earlier numbered case pending or within one year previously terminated action of this court?
Is this case a second or successive habeas corpus, social security appeal, or pro se civil rights case filed by the same individual?
A. Federal Question Cases:.
B. Diversity Jurisdiction Cases:.

sections.name: ARBITRATION CERTIFICATION
sentences: The effect of this certification is to remove the case from eligibility for arbitration.
Timothy Prol, Esq., counsel of record or pro se plaintiff, do hereby certify that the damages recoverable in this civil action case exceed the sum of $150,000.00 exclusive of interest and costs.
